[[File:Cabbage patch.gif|left|thumb|Cabbage growing in the garden.]]
Cabbage is a crop grown from [[cabbage seeds]] in the garden below the [[workyard]] in the kitchen garden. It can be purchased from the [[Farmer]].  Consuming cabbage provides {{Energy||5}}. 12 Cabbages are required for the [[Merchant|Merchant's]] quest. They do not have to be grown by the player. Cabbage is not an improvable crop. It does not have quality levels and cannot be improved with fertilizer.  It can only be made to grow faster.  See [[farming]] for more information on how crops are grown and improved.

==Alchemy==
Cabbage can be decomposed to powder and solution at the [[alchemy mill]] and [[hand mixer]], respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] will produce one additional reagent.
